offering_description.value: Amphastar develops and manufactures generic and branded medicines for hospitals, pharmacies and consumers. It supplies injectable, inhaled and nasal medicines through pharmaceutical wholesalers and retailers and sells active ingredients to drug manufacturers.

primary_products.value: injectable medicines; nasal glucagon and naloxone; over-the-counter epinephrine inhalers; insulin active ingredients

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical wholesalers, hospitals, pharmacy chains and drug manufacturers; B2C: consumers buying over-the-counter asthma inhalers through retailers

end_markets.value: hospital and emergency care; retail pharmacy; diabetes care; consumer respiratory care; pharmaceutical manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: finished prescription and over-the-counter medicines and active pharmaceutical ingredients

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: uses active ingredients and delivery components to make finished drugs for wholesalers and healthcare providers; component supplier: manufactures insulin active ingredients for other drugmakers

geography_served.value: global: primarily the United States, with operations in France and China and international sales of nasal glucagon

specialization.value: related lines: generic injectables, branded nasal medicines, over-the-counter inhalers and insulin active ingredients

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: pharmaceutical wholesalers supplying hospitals and pharmacies; third-party retail: pharmacies and major retailers selling over-the-counter inhalers; direct sales: active ingredient supply to pharmaceutical manufacturers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug approvals and manufacturing quality requirements enforced by the FDA and other national medicines regulators

notes: The current country-by-country sales footprint is uncertain.
